About the Position

PhD studentships in the Reisner Laboratory developing technologies to convert solar energy into sustainable fuels and chemicals open to home and international students. The official Cambridge microbiology studentship lists 2 November 2026 as its deadline; the exact submission time is not published.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentships at University of Cambridge Microbiology and Chemical Engineering
HostUniversity of Cambridge
LocationCambridge, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
StipendUKRI rate approximately £21805/year
Application Deadline2 November 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: PhD Studentships in Microbiology and Chemical Engineering Advancing Sustainable Technologies
  • Host Institution: University of Cambridge Yusuf Hamied Department of Chemistry
  • Supervisor: Professor Erwin Reisner
  • Location: Cambridge United Kingdom
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 4 years
  • Start Date: October 2027
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded (Competition Funded)
  • Stipend: UKRI rate (approximately £21,805/year)
  • Application Deadline: 2 November 2026
  • Eligibility: Open to home and international students worldwide

About the Programme

The Reisner Laboratory develops innovative technologies to convert solar energy into sustainable fuels and organic platform chemicals for a circular economy. The lab focuses on solar-powered conversion of waste water and air into fuels and chemicals. PhD students join a dynamic international cross-disciplinary team.

Key Research Areas

  • Solar energy conversion
  • Sustainable fuels production
  • Organic platform chemicals
  • Circular economy
  • Upcycling of plastic and biomass waste
  • CO2 valorisation to green fuels
  • Solar circular chemical industries
  • Biohybrid systems
  • Semi-artificial photosynthesis

Training & Development

Students work in a dynamic international research team with chemists physicists materials scientists chemical biologists synthetic biologists engineers and entrepreneurs. The lab provides access to state-of-the-art facilities at the Yusuf Hamied Department of Chemistry.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Hold or expect to obtain qualifications equivalent to UK first-class Master's degree or honours degree
  • Fields Microbiology Biochemistry Chemical Engineering or closely related discipline
  • Open to home and international students worldwide
  • Target Top candidates globally

Funding Details

  • Fully funded for 4 years
  • Tuition covered (home and international rates)
  • Stipend Standard UKRI research council rate (approximately £21,805/year for 2026/27)
  • Start October 2027

Contact

  • Email: pa-reisner@ch.cam.ac.uk

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www-reisner.ch.cam.ac.uk/positions

Source: www-reisner.ch.cam.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 2 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply
